在北京誤了歸程，臨時選擇民宿，沒想到邂逅了一處寶藏！藏在衚衕深處，位置雖偏卻充滿探尋的趣味。推開院門的瞬間，彷彿打開了新世界的大門，二樓的空間別有洞天，環境乾淨整潔，每一處細節都透着用心。
 
房間所需物品一應俱全，從洗漱用品到生活小物，都能感受到老闆的貼心。老闆更是熱情好客，擔心我天黑找不到路，還發詳細地址，服務太細緻了。
 
最驚喜的是樓頂露台！第二天清晨，陽光撒房間，打開房頂天窗，順着房間樓梯爬上屋頂。拿着麪包上樓吃早飯、喝着茶，微風輕拂，陽光被巧妙遮擋，在這樣愜意的氛圍中享用早餐，聽風聲低語，看天空澄澈，這一刻，時間都慢了下來。
下次來北京 還來住～😁
translatedContent:
A healing little world hidden in the alley✨

I missed my return trip in Beijing and chose a homestay temporarily. I didn't expect to encounter a treasure! Hidden deep in the alley, the location is remote but full of fun to explore. The moment I opened the courtyard door, it seemed to open the door to a new world. The space on the second floor is unique, the environment is clean and tidy, and every detail is thoughtful.

The room has everything you need, from toiletries to small items for daily life, you can feel the boss's thoughtfulness. The boss is even more hospitable. He was worried that I couldn't find the way in the dark, and he also sent a detailed address. The service was so meticulous.

The most surprising thing was the rooftop terrace! The next morning, the sun was shining in the room, the skylight on the roof was opened, and the stairs in the room climbed up to the roof. I took the bread upstairs to eat breakfast and drink tea. The breeze was blowing, and the sun was cleverly blocked. Enjoy breakfast in such a cozy atmosphere, listen to the whispering wind, and see the clear sky. At this moment, time has slowed down.
I will stay here again next time I come to Beijing~😁
